signal: Buy only when the first 30-minute open-to-close return is <= -0.5 times the median daily high-low range divided by close over the previous 20 complete sessions
entry: open 31 minutes after regular session open; one full minute latency after signal close
exit: open 120 minutes after entry; same regular session; one position per symbol per session
selection: no threshold, horizon, feature or symbol search
acceptance: positive aggregate net per common opportunity and session-bootstrap 95 percent lower bound at 10bps; positive net in at least 6 of 8 calendar-quarter folds and 4 of 6 symbols; beats always-long; at least 30 selections per fold
stop_rule: one conclusive failed evaluation retires the hypothesis; no automated retries after claim; invalid data blocks evaluation without consuming budget
holdout_policy: never read by development evaluator; future data unavailable now; no automatic promotion or holdout evaluation
